At present time she is most concerned about the increasing severity of pain, which is affecting her ability to function. When you examine Patient D, you confirm that she has a left foot drop with diminished sensation in the sole of her foot. You order an MRI, which reveals an L5-S1 disc herniation with associated canal stenosis and left neuroforaminal stenosis.
